articles.title: New guidance for selling tenanted properties
articles.summary: The new guidance is account of the Renters Rights Act
articles.ai_summary:

- Sellers must now navigate updated regulations to ensure compliance when transferring ownership of rental units.

articles.title: Councils fail to collect millions in fines from landlords
articles.summary: The NRLA used Freedom of Information requests to find out
articles.ai_summary:
- Councils across the UK are missing out on millions in landlord fines, as revealed by the NRLA's Freedom of Information revelations.  
- Many local authorities are failing to enforce penalties, highlighting a significant gap in compliance and revenue collection in housing regulations.

articles.title: Rental stock drops as Renters Rights Act kicks in
articles.summary: The total number of homes to rent is now 1% lower than a year ago.
articles.ai_summary:
- Rental stock in the UK has decreased by 1% over the past year as the Renters Rights Act is implemented.  
- The reduction in available homes for rent could intensify competition and drive up rental prices.

articles.ai_summary:

- The UK property market demonstrates signs of stabilization amidst rising rental prices.
